title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - EvidenceTemplate
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/EvidenceTemplate. The template of an evidence that the Data Consumer must present to get access to the data product instance.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'EvidenceTemplate'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

verifiableClaimTemplate.description: Property. A Verifiable Credential template that can be used to demonstrate compliance to a constraint.

acceptedIssuers.description: Relationship. A list of trusted issuers for the above template. Links to one or more LegalPerson entities.
